value.0: The Rodian before you is dressed in beautiful blue attire. In her hand is a holo puck, with imagery of star ships. She casually flips through them as he idly waits in the Hall.

This ugnaught seems constantly working on something. Dressed in a sleek black flame retardant suit, and a stunning dusters hat, she is just about ready to build anything. 

On her data pad are blueprints of all different kinds of structures, and furniture alike.
This rather strong looking Trandoshan has all sorts of metal cutting, and shaping tools on him. He carries with him a data pad with all sorts of weapon and armor blueprints.
Nalka Rinn is a grotto hunt caller tied to the Primal Overrun capstone trials in Dathomir Grotto Apex Den.
Talra Venn is a jungle preserve handler tied to the Apex Bite capstone trials in Dathomir Tarn Jungle Preserve.
If it is anything like SWLOR's server it has a bunch of hampsters inside.
